speaker: john_heminges
text: Three baskets, the hamper, and no more. The trestles are the inn's. Stack them, and leave them stacked.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The books go in my arms. No other hand.

speaker: hired_men
text: The hamper is shut, Master Heminges. Three baskets beside it. The cords are new.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nick is with me, behind the cart. Sam, thou art on thy feet.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: The ostlers are at it already.

speaker: (an ostler, from the hay-loft)
text: The cue, boy. We have heard this comedy forty times. We can give it you from here.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Then give it late. You always come in early, and the loft is not the book.

speaker: (the ostler)
text: Early is how a yard learns a play. God keep the other twin, wherever you have left him.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: They know the shape of it better than a man who has played it once.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let them keep the shape. We are not playing it between the baskets.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot is in the chest. Two locks. Both keys are on me.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Host. The last week's yard-money.

speaker: (the host)
text: I have it when you have set it where I can see it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thirteen shillings and fourpence. On the sill, and then in your hand. The week is paid.

speaker: (the host)
text: Thirteen and four. I have counted it twice. You are clear of me.

speaker: (the host)
text: At Michaelmas, then, masters, if my lord writes again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: If he writes, the trestles will know the way of it.

speaker: hired_men
text: The cart is at the gate. Eightpence up Bishopsgate Street. He will take the street, not the ditch.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eightpence, and paid at the door up there, not in this yard. A carter paid early remembers a hill.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am walking. I am not a basket.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The books are not a basket either.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: They are not going in the cart. I have said so twice.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: May I sit the tail of it, for the hill?

speaker: john_heminges
text: No. Thou wilt be under a basket at the first stone, and I am not explaining thee.

speaker: (the ostler)
text: Bring the comedy back after Easter. The loft will still have the cues.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep them. We shall want a yard that remembers.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The trestles look smaller from the gate.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Leave them. They are not ours.
